svg.text: Solvay Spark Spine AI — Technical Architecture
Anthropic SDK tool loop · psycopg · neo4j driver · hindsight-client
Arrows = request / data direction · an arrow to a layer = used by several of its parts · dark boxes = cloud services
Runtime: one Docker image (python:3.12-slim, UI built on node:22) · compose: app, pgvector/pg18, ollama, neo4j:5-community
Hindsight runs in its own environment (not in compose) · sign-in guards the pages only; /api stays open — run on localhost
